title: VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Major Depressive Disorder
organization: Department of Veterans Affairs and Department of Defense
citation: Department of Veterans Affairs and Department of Defense. VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Major Depressive Disorder. Version 4.0. Washington, DC; 2022.
populations: Adults with possible or diagnosed major depressive disorder

accessPolicy.note: The complete guideline is publicly downloadable from the issuing federal agencies. Government-authored portions are generally public domain in the United States, but the document also contains contractor-supported material and a sidebar explicitly reproducing DSM-5 criteria. Embedded instruments, criteria text, tables, images, and other credited elements require item-level review. This pass records verified metadata and permits protected local extraction only; it does not authorize structured criteria extraction or derived clinical content.
